item.title: Squatters in tent in bushy area of Kelsey Park, 9th August
item.description:
Whilst in Kelsey Park today we noticed a tent with people going in and out of it, in a secluded bushy area of Kelsey Park. The people looked like rough sleepers/ drug users and with such a busy park and young children around, it is essential that Bromley Council have this removed as soon as possible. Not sure how long the tent has been there, but it is in the bushes on the right when you you enter the park from the Wickham road entrance (instead of turning left towards the play ground area). As this should be covered by Bromley’s Pleasure Grounds bylaws 9 - whereby tents cannot be erected on such grounds. We hope this issue will be addressed quickly.
